reason: A puts an operable, clearly labelled report in the first screen at every width, handles every edge state with written feedback, and properly recomposes for the phone, while B's strongest idea (the annotated terminal) only works at 1440 and degrades into a clipped terminal and detached list on phones. B has the clearer headline and a tighter page, and if A's length and its leaning on the lede bothered me more than B's mobile execution, I would move closer to a tie.
